capabilities_required: executor_port (caller-injected; synthetic adapters only in this repository)
authority_notes: Only synthetic executor adapters exist, so no real restart/isolation/restore/rollback is reachable. Approval, policy, target, expiry, maintenance lease, and (for recovery) an exact backup generation with an isolated-restore proof ref are validated before the port is touched; refusals and executions are terminal idempotent receipts that carry no health vocabulary. Binding a real executor is a separately Owner-gated leaf.
